data.title: reckon MCP server
data.phase: scaffold landed — store.py working, server.py sketch, mcp SDK wiring deferred
data.summary: MCP transport for plan state — same writes as docs-server, callable from any MCP client.

transport.rationale: Claude Code uses stdio by default; SSE transport can be added later once the mcp SDK SSE server helper stabilises

sections.body: Removes dependency on docs-server being reachable over HTTP. Agent calls reckon.patch_plan as a first-class tool, not an HTTP curl.
9 tools: read_plan, list_plans, patch_plan, append_comment, lock_decision, append_followup, resolve_followup, set_status, set_impl.
Mirrors POST /state/<project>/<doc>: atomic rename, _version optimistic concurrency, 412 on conflict.
Editable install for now. uv tool install reckon-mcp once published.
transport (locked: stdio first), search (open), multi-project (open), index-write (open).

followups.title: Wire mcp SDK and validate end-to-end with Claude Code
followups.body: store.py is working code. server.py has the tool logic but the FastMCP SDK registration is a sketch pending `uv pip install mcp`. Next step: install the mcp package, wire @mcp.tool() decorators, and test with `claude mcp add reckon-mcp`.
followups.prompt:
Project: reckon-mcp
Plan:    reckon-mcp-plan
Section: server.py SDK wiring
Tier:    sonnet

Context
  store.py is fully implemented (commit cd6aa88). server.py has all tool
  logic but the FastMCP SDK registration is a sketch — the mcp package
  is not yet installed and the @mcp.tool() decorators are only applied
  when the import succeeds.

State to read
  ~/Code/reckon-mcp/src/reckon_mcp/server.py
  ~/Code/reckon-mcp/src/reckon_mcp/store.py

Locked decisions to honour
  transport -> stdio first

Open decisions to surface
  search, multi-project, index-write

Constraints
  Python >=3.12, uv, mcp>=1.0.0, pydantic>=2.0
  Do not modify store.py (working code)
  Do not add SSE transport yet (deferred decision)

Done-when
  1. uv pip install mcp succeeds
  2. reckon-mcp stdio server starts and lists tools (claude mcp add reckon-mcp + claude mcp list)
  3. reckon.read_plan returns data for a known plan
  4. reckon.patch_plan writes and bumps _version
  5. tests still pass (uv run pytest)
  6. this followup marked resolved + new followup written
